_note: REACHED VIA PROBE: AdvancedScreen reads and writes through
`composer.getProjectSettings()/setProjectSettings()`, so a four-method stub
is the whole dependency. Hosted in the board's own pane —
`.bd-set-pane-body` at 824, which is 760 (the card) plus its two 32 insets.
Same host and arithmetic as s7-settings-general.
A trap worth writing down: the stub passes NO `customCode` key. The screen
reads `s.customCode ?? DEFAULT_CUSTOM_CODE`, so an empty object is TRUTHY
and hands it three undefined strings — the case threw on `.trim()` and
rendered nothing, which looks exactly like a broken selector.
ALREADY CONFORMANT on all three cards: 24 properties. The chassis arrived
with s7-settings-general's family-wide move to settings/shared.tsx and this
screen inherited it whole. The card titles match the board's exactly —
HEAD SCRIPTS / BODY SCRIPTS (END) / GLOBAL CSS — because the CSS uppercases
them; nothing was renamed.
CODE CHANGED — A MEASURED CONTRAST FAILURE, not drift. The screen opens with
a warning banner, and it painted --bk-warning (#C27803, which is the FILL
colour of a warning) as TEXT over its own hand-mixed rgba(217,119,6,0.08)
wash: 2.94:1 at 12px, on the two longest strings on the screen (the ⚠ line
and the `<script src="…">` inside it). The token system already carries the
right pair — --bk-warning-tint as ground, --bk-warning-text #723B13 as ink,
8.69:1 — and the two hand-mixed rgba()s were the only reason the composite
differed from it. Now tokens, same shape as SCREEN_ERROR / SCREEN_SUCCESS in
shared.tsx. NO BOARD DRAWS THIS BANNER, so conforming did not cause it and
nothing on the Figma side constrains the fix. This is the class of failure
the harness's new oklab/oklch reader surfaces: the composite was unreadable
to the old parser, so the surface would have passed silently.
NOT JOINED, and this is the substance of what the board wants that the
product does not have:
639:4458 / 639:4464 / 639:4470 — each card holds a FIELD (the 180 label
column, 16 gap) whose control is a 520-wide `code` block on --color/bg-subtle
at radius 6, 12/10 padding, 12px Geist Mono in ink-soft. Live puts a
full-width flowbite <Textarea> straight into the card with no label column
at all — the card title is the only label, and the aria-label is the only
thing naming the field to a screen reader. So the board draws a labelled,
fixed-width, mono code well and the product draws an unlabelled textarea.
That is a control swap plus a layout change, on three cards, and it wants
a decision about whether a settings TEXTAREA gets the 180 column the way
an input does — a chassis question of the same size as the one
s7-settings-general settled, not a per-screen one. FLAGGED, not taken.
639:4460 / 639:4466 / 639:4472 — the code blocks themselves, for the same
reason: there is no live element at that address to measure.
FOUND, NOT FIXED: the board draws no warning banner at all, while the screen
leads with one saying inline JavaScript is stripped at publish. That caveat
is load-bearing — the export sanitizer really does drop inline scripts — so
it stays; but the board is drawing a custom-code screen that accepts custom
code, and the product ships one that accepts only external <script src>.
Same shape as the Headers board's missing 'Not yet enforced' banner and the
Analytics board's missing consent caveat: three boards in this family draw
features whose product versions carry a disclaimer the board never got.
